content: B2B SaaS trial norms: 14 days is the modal/sweet-spot length for B2B SaaS; 7 days for simple fast-time-to-value products, 21-30 for complex ones with migration/integration. Credit-card-required (opt-out) trials convert 35-55% (median ~44%) vs no-card (opt-in) trials at 8-22% (median ~14%), but no-card trials draw far more signups and show better 90-day retention. Guidance by price: products under ~USD50/mo generally do NOT require a card; over ~USD200/mo often do. Trial-expiry behavior differs: card-required auto-converts unless cancelled; no-card requires an explicit upgrade action, so the product must have an explicit 'trial ended' state and an upgrade path.
